Data completeness: full month, real administrative boundary — 3257 recorded incidents for 2026-06, queried against Barnet's actual ONS 2021 polygon outline (the same shape shown on the map above), not an approximate circle. This is the complete monthly response from the UK Police API for that exact area. Day score: 2.3886 weighted incidents/1,000 people (93% of the 32-borough average). Night score: 9.045 weighted incidents/1,000 people (71% of the 32-borough average). Both are normalised by plain 2021 resident population (389,300) — no separate workday/footfall figure exists for Barnet in the ONS's 2011 workday-population release (the most recent one published), so no correction is applied here (ratio 1.0) rather than guessing one. This means Barnet's score may be slightly overstated relative to boroughs where a real commuter/footfall correction could be applied — see methodology. Rated against the average of the 32 boroughs currently on the automated pipeline.
